name: Mental Breakdown Minnesota 2019
information: This competition does not have 3x3 Speedsolve! It will hold some more challenging events like Blindfolded and Fewest Moves Solving. If you are interested in a competition with 3x3 Speedsolve, please look at [Minnesota Qualifier 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaQualifier2019) on June 22nd and 23rd! The main event of this competition is 3x3x3 Fewest Moves.
